title: Note: storage amended — a nested thing is a directory

text: Agreed and amended: what was said stays an append-only stream per card written only by Servex (so the naming checks and the fold keep working); what a card IS — its fields, its sub-pages, its variations — lives in a directory ai/cards/<slug>/ using the same persistence every page already has (page.json, the Saver system), loaded on demand, one level deeper as another directory. Tomorrow's build begins with a survey of the persistence we already have, so nothing new is invented.
